name: Bienoise
description: FAILURE AS GOAL combines Bienoise’s laptop compositions and his non-musical finds: contemplative yet disruptive electronic music materializes the meaningfulness of what is not yet signal in a site-specific performance. Music neither for the body nor for the mind, but soundtracks for empty stages.
bio: Alberto Ricca is Bienoise, a laptop composer released by Mille Plateaux. A researcher of what is not yet music, writes scores for contemporary dance.
